parameters.binning_reference_policy: explicit reference or current input; fitted once per axis across all scopes/targets
parameters.sample_share_denominator: all samples including special bins, per target/group/period
parameters.confidence_interval: unweighted integer Wilson; weighted CI unsupported
parameters.amount_policy: existing helper: nonnegative amounts contribute; negative/null/NaN contribute zero; infinity rejected
parameters.score_missing_policy: null/NaN/custom missing_values -> missing; nonfinite/nonnumeric/probability domain violation -> invalid
parameters.sample_semantics: historical sample retention; population extrapolation unknown
